verdict.rationale: WorkOS's MCP server (workos-docs-9, workos-docs-15, workos-docs-44) lets an agent act on WorkOS dashboard data when invoked, and Directory Sync pushes event updates via webhooks (workos-docs-21), but there is no evidence of a scheduling/automation engine or persistent unattended background jobs — MCP access is invocation-based tool access, not autonomous background automation. Missing for 10: any scheduler/trigger system, evidence of agents running unattended over time, or documented autonomous workflow execution.
